7: ## Linux browser and WebGPU capture
8:

10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.

- Central piazza at (0,0): circular cobble area r=18, fountain (0,0), duomo at north end (0,-26) with dome and bell tower, café on east (18,0) with awning + tables, market stalls on west (-16, 5), apartment/home south-west (-30, 20) with bed/shower/kitchen, gym maybe (30,-20), fashion boutique (30,15) DLC, canal at north-east? Sky: large sphere with gradient shader adjusting by time of day; sun directional light; fog matching. Night: stars (points) fade in, window emissive lights, lamps, moon light.

Character: stylized but detailed-ish. Build from primitives with smooth shading: head (sphere), hair cap, neck, torso (capsule/box), arms with elbow segments, hands, legs, shoes. Simulation tick: each real second at 1x advances game minutes (e.g., 1 real second = 1 game minute? Too fast: 24h=24min; good). Needs decay per game hour. For 1x speed, 1 sec = 0.5 game min maybe. Day of 24 mins real is long for demo. Use 1 sec = 1 game min at 1x; so day 24 real min; speeds 2x/4x. For actions, advance time instantly with animation overlay ~2s. let current = 'pt';

export function setLang(lang) {
  if (dict[lang]) current = lang;
  document.documentElement.lang = LANGS[current].html;
  return current;
}

export function getLang() { return current; }

export function t(key, vars = {}) {
  const table = dict[current] || dict.pt;
  let value = table[key];
  if (value === undefined) value = dict.en[key] ?? key;
  if (typeof value === 'string') {
    return value.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (m, k) => (vars[k] !== undefined ? String(vars[k]) : m));
  }
  return value;
}

export function tr(key, vars) {
  const v = t(key, vars);
  return Array.isArray(v) ? v : [v];
}

## Objective
- Build a browser-based, InZOI-style realistic life simulation game set in Italy, with all DLC included and full Italian, Portuguese, and English localization, delivered as a static web app in `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround`.

## Requirements
- Life-sim gameplay inspired by InZOI: character creation, needs, careers, relationships, time/day cycle, DLC.
- Setting: Italy (built as fictional coastal town “Porto Sereno”).
- Languages: Italiano, Português, English, switchable at runtime.
- “All DLC” must be included and functional, not just labels.
- Must run via static `index.html` + assets (no framework at root; package.json would trigger unsupported project behavior).
- Use local assets; no dependency on external CDNs.
- Mobile-responsive with touch controls (AGENTS.md also requires this).

## Decisions
- Built custom 3D world with Three.js r180 vendored locally (`vendor/three.module.js`, `vendor/three.core.js`) via import map.
- Vendored Cormorant Garamond (display/serif) and Manrope (UI) woff2 fonts in `assets/fonts/`.
- Created 7 functional DLC zones: `mare`, `toscana`, `roma`, `venezia`, `moda`, `amore`, `pets`, each with a 3D district, hotspot, and career/activity; toggling hides the zone and its colliders.
- Architecture: ES modules split into `js/i18n.js`, `js/data.js`, `js/gl/*` (helpers, environment, building, landmarks, scenery, districts, index), `js/character.js`, plus planned `js/ui.js`, `js/game.js`, `js/main.js`.
- Custom procedural character models, textures (cobblestone, plaster, roof, grass, sand, signs), water/sky shaders, day-night lighting, weather, NPC walking loops, pets, minimap, quest system.
- Game design includes 5 needs (energy, hunger, hygiene, social, fun), 8 careers, relationships/dating/marriage, time speed 0/1×/2×/4×, autosave via localStorage, action panels, quests, DLC manager, settings, help, map modal.

## Work State
### Completed
- Three.js and font assets vendored.
- Full trilingual dictionary in `js/i18n.js` (~all UI/actions/DLC/careers/traits/dialogs/toasts).
- Game data in `js/data.js`: DLCS, CAREERS, TRAITS, OUTFITS, SKIN_TONES, HAIR_COLORS/STYLES, NAMES, NPCS, PETS, SPOTS, DISTRICT_NAMES.
- Character and pet builders in `js/character.js`.
- 3D world modules: helpers, environment (sky/sea/fog/lights/rain/clouds/day-night), building generators, landmarks (fountain, duomo, café, home, gym), scenery (piazza, market, promenade, filler buildings, trees, props, NPCs), DLC districts, world index with markers/collisions/update.
- Complete `index.html`: splash, menu, character creator, game HUD, modals, progress, banner, toasts, language menu, SVG icon sprite.
- Complete CSS: `css/style.css` (fonts/base/menu/creator/responsive) and `css/game.css` (HUD/modals/mobile).
- DLC pedestrian collision tags and canal blocking conditional on `venezia` enabled.

### Active
- Writing `js/ui.js` (earlier referred to as `ui.js`), then `js/game.js` and `js/main.js`.

let current = 'pt';

export function setLang(lang) {
  if (dict[lang]) current = lang;
  document.documentElement.lang = LANGS[current].html;
  return current;
}

export function getLang() { return current; }

export function t(key, vars = {}) {
  const table = dict[current] || dict.pt;
  let value = table[key];
  if (value === undefined) value = dict.en[key] ?? key;
  if (typeof value === 'string') {
    return value.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (m, k) => (vars[k] !== undefined ? String(vars[k]) : m));
  }
  return value;
}

export function tr(key, vars) {
  const v = t(key, vars);
  return Array.isArray(v) ? v : [v];
}

Forward direction relative camera yaw: pressing W move away from camera? Typical: camera at yaw angle behind player, W moves forward in direction camera looks (from camera to target). Define camera offset = (sin(yaw)*cosPitch*dist, sinPitch*dist, cos(yaw)*cosPitch*dist). Camera looks at target. Then forward = normalize(target - camera on xz) = (-sin(yaw), -cos(yaw)). At yaw=0 camera at +z behind, forward -z, start player facing fountain (-z), good. PlayerYaw = atan2(moveX, moveZ) with +z as facing? buildCharacter faces +z (nose at +z). If moving forward -z, atan2(0,-1)=π, consistent.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a browser-based, InZOI-style realistic life simulation game set in Italy, with all DLC included and full Italian, Portuguese, and English localization, delivered as a static web app in `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround`.

## Requirements
- Life-sim gameplay inspired by InZOI: character creation, needs, careers, relationships, time/day cycle, DLC.
- Setting: Italy, presented as fictional coastal town “Porto Sereno”.
- Languages: Italiano, Português, English, switchable at runtime.
- “All DLC” must be included and functional, not just labels.
- Must run via static `index.html` + assets; do not add root `package.json`.
- Use local assets only; no external CDNs.
- Mobile-responsive with touch controls.

## Decisions
- Custom 3D world using Three.js r180 vendored locally; import map maps `three` to `vendor/three.module.js`.
- Vendored fonts in `assets/fonts/`; no network dependencies.
- Seven functional DLC zones: `mare`, `toscana`, `roma`, `venezia`, `moda`, `amore`, `pets`.
- ES-module architecture: `js/i18n.js`, `js/data.js`, `js/gl/*`, `js/character.js`, `js/ui.js`, `js/game.js`, `js/main.js`.
- Game uses localStorage save key `vita.save.v1`; no backend.
- 5 needs, 8 careers, 6 quests (including pet), relationships/dating/marriage, speed 0/1×/2×/4×, DLC manager, map/diary/settings/help modals.
- Service through runtime server; no root package manifest.

## Work State

### Completed
- Three.js and font assets vendored.
- Complete trilingual dictionary in `js/i18n.js`.
- Game content in `js/data.js`: DLCs, careers, traits, outfits, skin/hair palettes, names, NPCs, pets, spots, district names.
- Character and pet builders in `js/character.js`.
- Full 3D world modules: environment, buildings, landmarks, scenery, seven DLC districts, markers, collisions, NPCs, pets, day-night/weather.
- Complete `index.html` DOM and CSS.
- `js/ui.js` created: screen management, language switching, creator binding, HUD, prompts, modal shell, spot actions, NPC/relationship modals, career modal, diary/quests, DLC manager, map, wardrobe, settings, help, progress layer, toasts, banners.
- `js/game.js` created: state/save/load, new/continue, player model, movement, collision, camera orbit, interactions, actions, clock, needs, weather, careers, relationships, marriage, quests, DLC toggles, pets, outfits, minimap/world map canvas, autosave, keyboard/touch controls, sound hooks.
- Fixed piazza spot to `(0, 6)`.
- Fixed Roma arcade skip list to `[3,4,5,9,12]`.
- Removed Amore flower bed overlapping the zone sign.
- Changed Venetian canal houses to `rotY: 0` to face the canal.
- Added `#btn-help` HUD button and related CSS `.modal-card.wide`, `.modal-foot .danger-link`.
- Patched help modal description keys and disabled remote career applications.
- Fixed double need-decay in game loop and camera target initialization.

### Active
- `js/main.js` is still missing, so the app cannot boot yet.
- Need to integrate renderer, main scene/world, menu cinematic camera, creator studio scene, audio engine, UI callbacks, game loop, resize, quality/fullscreen/reset hooks.

### Blocked
- Nothing blocked; implementation incomplete until `js/main.js` exists and runtime testing is done.

## Next Move
1. Create `js/main.js`:
   - WebGLRenderer on `#scene`, scene/camera, `createWorld`, `UI`, `Game`, UI callbacks.
   - Menu orbit camera around Porto Sereno at golden hour.
   - Separate creator studio scene with rotating platform, lighting, and `buildCharacter` preview.
   - Audio engine for music/SFX volumes via Web Audio.
   - Wire new game, continue, creator begin/back, quality, fullscreen, reset/reload, autosave hooks.
   - Boot flow: load fonts, hide splash, show menu; render loop by mode `menu|creator|game`; resize handling.
2. Start app with runtime server and load in Playwright; check console errors.
3. Fix runtime/UI issues found: creator preview, modal actions, navigation, progress overlay, map drawing, touch controls, DLC toggles.
4. Verify desktop 1440×900 and mobile 390×844; capture screenshots.
5. Confirm all screens/controls work, language switching updates content, all 7 DLC toggles hide/show zones and careers.
6. Update `README.md` with controls/features and final screenshots.
7. Commit the untracked project files when validation passes.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/main.js`: missing entry module; must be created for boot.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: screen/modal DOM, import map, script reference to `js/main.js`.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/ui.js`: UI API used by `main.js` and `game.js`.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/game.js`: Game API and simulation rules.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/gl/index.js`: `createWorld(renderer, scene)` returning `{ctx, update, setDLC, setPet, isBlocked, spots, dlcs}`.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/gl/environment.js`: `createContext`, sky/lighting/water/day-night.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/character.js`: `buildCharacter`, `buildPet`.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/data.js`: DLC/career/trait/spot/NPC/pet definitions.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/i18n.js`: `t()`, `tr()`, `setLang()`, `getLang()`, `LANGS`.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/css/style.css`: fonts/base/menu/creator styles; imports `game.css`.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/css/game.css`: HUD/modal/responsive styles.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/start.sh`: starts app via runtime default server.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/README.md`: still needs game documentation.

## Important Context
- Start server with `node "$RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/default-start.mjs"`; it serves project root and expects `index.html`. Do not add root `package.json`.

[130.81,196,261.63,329.63].forEach((f,i)=>{osc...})
padGain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.22, now+4)

const buffer = ctx.createBuffer(1, ctx.sampleRate*4, ctx.sampleRate); fill random * 0.2 with smoothing; source loop; biquad lowpass 600; gain .05 -> music bus.

this.stepIndex=0; this.ambientTimer = setInterval(...)
notes = [523.25,659.25,783.99,659.25,587.33,...]

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a browser-based, InZOI-style realistic life simulation game set in fictional Italian coastal town “Porto Sereno”, with all DLC included and full Italian, Portuguese, and English localization, delivered as a static web app in `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround`.

## Requirements
- Life-sim gameplay inspired by InZOI: character creation, needs, careers, relationships, time/day cycle, DLC.
- All seven DLCs must be functional, not just labeled.
- Languages: Italiano, Português, English, switchable at runtime.
- Static `index.html` + assets; no root `package.json`, no external CDNs.
- Mobile-responsive with touch controls.
- Local assets only.

## Decisions
- Custom Three.js r180 world vendored locally; import map maps `three` to `vendor/three.module.js`.
- Vendored fonts in `assets/fonts/`.
- Seven functional DLC zones: `mare`, `toscana`, `roma`, `venezia`, `moda`, `amore`, `pets`.
- ES-module architecture: `js/i18n.js`, `js/data.js`, `js/gl/*`, `js/character.js`, `js/ui.js`, `js/game.js`, `js/main.js`.
- localStorage save key `vita.save.v1`; no backend.
- 5 needs, 8 careers, 6 quests, relationships/dating/marriage, speed 0/1×/2×/4×, DLC manager, map/diary/settings/help modals.
- `js/main.js` owns renderer, menu orbit camera, separate creator studio scene, Web Audio synth engine, animation loop, resize/quality/fullscreen hooks.
- Debug surface `window.__vita = { game, ui, world, scene, camera, renderer, audio }` added for automated checks.

## Work State

### Completed
- Three.js and font assets vendored.
- Complete trilingual dictionary in `js/i18n.js`; all used action/career/spot/DLC/trait keys verified in IT/PT/EN with no missing keys.
- Content data, character/pet builders, environment, buildings, landmarks, scenery, all seven DLC districts, markers, collisions, NPCs, pets, day-night/weather.
- Complete `index.html`, `css/style.css`, `css/game.css`.
- Complete `js/ui.js` and `js/game.js`.
- Created `js/main.js`: boot flow, renderer, menu cinematic, creator studio with orbit/drag, Web Audio ambient music/SFX, language persistence, quality switching, fullscreen, reset, save/continue integration, render loop, resize handling.
- Fixed missing `_bindGlobal` in `UI` (was crashing constructor).
- Fixed missing `bougainvillea` import in `js/gl/scenery.js`.
- Fixed main camera far plane from 420 to 900 so sky sphere renders; menu hour adjusted to 17.65 for golden-hour look.
- Fixed mobile creator camera: dynamic stage-aware view offset, distance based on stage size; character now fully visible.
- Refined `buildCharacter` proportions (narrower torso/chest/hips, visible neck, slimmer arms); added studio glow plane and frontal face light.
- Fixed mobile HUD overflow at 390px; hides help on compact screens and reduces icon sizes.
- Fixed quest chip overlapping minimap by moving top to `312px`.
- Fixed mobile banner position to `31%` so it no longer overlaps needs panel.
- Replaced invalid `game.sound('pause')` call with `game.sfx('pause')` in `ui.js`.
- Added date money check (`€20`) in `Game.canRelate`.
- Runtime tested desktop and mobile: menu, creator, game, spot actions, career apply/work shift, relationships/chat, date/propose/wedding, pet adoption/play, DLC toggles all 7 zones + careers, save/continue, language switching.
- All DLC zones/actions smoke-tested; pet DLC off hides pet and re-enable restores it.
- Screenshots captured in `/tmp/opencode/` for menu, creator, game, modals, mobile, pet.

### Active
- Landscape-phone layout needs fixes: 844×390 creator panel is only 146px tall with heading/footer overlap; game needs panel overlaps joystick; banner/toasts overlap controls.
- `README.md` still lacks game documentation.
- Project files remain untracked/uncommitted.

### Blocked
- Nothing blocking; remaining work is responsive polish, documentation, final validation, and commit.

## Next Move
1. Add landscape CSS for `(max-width:980px) and (max-height:520px)`: shrink/hide creator heading, compact panel/footer, allocate ~104px creator stage; scale/hide needs panel so joystick/touch controls do not overlap; adjust banner/toast placement.
2. Update `applyCreatorCamera` to derive camera offset/distance from actual `#cc-stage` bounding rect rather than fixed `0.305H`/`-0.115W`.
3. Re-test landscape 844×390 and mobile 390×844 after CSS changes; capture final screenshots.
4. Re-test desktop 1440×900 menu/creator/game after character/lighting changes.
5. Verify pet DLC re-enable restores `ctx.pet.model.group.visible === true`.
6. Update `README.md` with controls, features, DLC list, localization, how to run, and screenshots.
7. Run final console-error check, then commit all untracked project files.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/main.js`: entry module; boot, cameras, audio, creator preview, render loop.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/css/game.css`: HUD/modal/mobile/landscape CSS; landscape fixes pending.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/css/style.css`: menu/creator styles; creator layout base.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/game.js`: simulation, state, actions, careers, relationships, DLC, save/map.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/ui.js`: screens, creator bindings, HUD, modals, prompts, DLC/map/settings/help.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/character.js`: `buildCharacter` / `buildPet`; recently slimmed proportions.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/gl/index.js`: `createWorld`, DLC groups, world update.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/gl/scenery.js`: fixed `bougainvillea` import.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/data.js`: DLCs, careers, traits, outfits, spots, NPCs, pets.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/i18n.js`: complete trilingual dictionary.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: DOM, import map, `js/main.js` script.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/README.md`: still generic template; needs game docs.
- `/tmp/opencode/`: Playwright test scripts and screenshots (`boot-test.js`, `flow-test.js`, `ui-test.js`, `dlc-test.js`, `mechanics-test.js`, `dlc-actions-test.js`, `mobile-test*.js`, `landscape-test.js`).

## Important Context
- Start server with `node "$RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/default-start.mjs"` (currently running on `0.0.0.0:3000`). Do not add root `package.json`.
- Playwright: use Node `playwright-core` from `/home/runner/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/node_modules/playwright-core`; launch `executablePath:'/usr/bin/chromium'` under `DISPLAY=:0` (Xvfb) with `--no-sandbox --disable-dev-shm-usage --enable-gpu --ignore-gpu-blocklist --use-angle=swiftshader`.
- Software rendering is very slow; movement/time simulation may advance only a few frames per second. Use debug positioning (`window.__vita.game.state.player`) and `setQuality('low')` for tests.
- `UI` constructor callbacks: `onNewGame`, `onContinue`, `onCreatorBack`, `onCreatorBegin`, `onCreatorChange`, `onFullscreen`, `onReset`, `onModalChange`.
- `Game` constructor: `new Game({ world, renderer, camera, ui, hooks })`; hooks `onStart`, `setQuality`, `volume`, `sfx`.
- `Game` spots/actions: piazza at `(0,6)` radius `4.0`; cafe `(19,2)`; shelter `(-24,30)`; all DLC spot definitions in `js/data.js`.
- Work shift requires career at matching spot; career buttons from HUD are intentionally disabled (`opt.remote`), apply via spot panel.
- DLC toggle selector is `[data-dlc="<id>"]`; turning pets off calls `world.setPet(null)` but keeps `state.pet`, and re-enable recreates it.
- All project files untracked; no commit yet.
